g.desc: Title: Optional current acquisition front end
Voltage-output CT only: 0.333Vrms at rated current, with internal burden. No mains voltage divider.
This sheet is an analog prototype. High-rate acquisition and qualified anti-alias filtering are still required.
Select CT rating for each motor. At 50A / 0.333Vrms: bias +/-0.471V peak at rated current.
RC corner ~=1.59kHz; this single pole is not a complete anti-alias or surge-protection solution.
Verify clamp leakage, source impedance, rail injection and fault behavior. Detect inrush clipping in acquisition.
